name: Inmate Contraband
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve orange cropped uniform, flat-top hair, fist-emblem orange clogs, belt chain and cloth stash sack. Keep phone screens dark or warm white during action; source pale-blue screens may need masking if reproduced. Review bag/prop continuity, clean effect boundaries and title.

result.prompt:
Create an EPIC 5-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

Inmate Contraband — Hidden Stash.
IDENTITY: exact muscular adult dark-skinned man with short flat-top curls and faded sides, stern face, orange short-sleeve button-front uniform with calf-length trousers, black belt with silver buckle and hip chain, orange ventilated clogs with white FIST emblems. Preserve his small brown cloth sack containing black phones, portable batteries and red/white snack boxes. Keep those objects recognizable, with no new brand labels.
0–0.7s: establish full body, crouched over the little sack. He glances left and right, then grips its opening and gives the bag one sharp upward shake.
0.7–2.5s: an IMPOSSIBLY LONG connected stream of phones, battery bricks and snack boxes erupts upward from the tiny sack. Camera rockets backward to reveal the stream curling into one enormous clenched mechanical FIST made from these chunky objects, five times his height, on a long articulated arm of stash items. He swings the bag like a flail handle; the colossal supply-fist arcs through deep perspective and punches a suspended charcoal training pad far into the cyan distance. One huge bounded orange/ivory impact star, a hard contact hold, and a receding pad whistle. Keep his full body visible in the wide reveal. This is absurd cartoon prop magic, not a technical device assembly sequence.
2.5–3.5s: he jerks the little sack once and the immense object-arm rapidly zips back inside it in reverse order. Camera snap-zooms toward his knowing face as exact title HIDDEN STASH slams beneath it. All backing around the finite object silhouettes remains cyan, no environment.
3.5–5s: full-body hero hold. He draws the sack closed as if it weighs nothing. One last tiny phone pops up; he pushes it back down with one finger, then gives the bag a possessive pat. SFX: fabric rattle, rapidly accelerating clattering supply eruption, immense swinging whoosh, dominant padded metal THOOM, fast retracting rattle, title slam and tiny electronic chirp. No speech or music. Phone screens stay dark or warm white, no cyan glow.
